evidence: High-purity ZrCl4 and O2 gas of 99.99 and 99.995% were used as the Zr and O sources, respectively. ZrCl4 was evaporated at 423 K and introduced into the growth zone with purified N2 as a carrier gas. Oxidation was carried out using O2, which was introduced into the deposition zone with purified N2 as well.
